description: This PHP source file defines the Register controller for the Opencart e-commerce platform. It manages user registration by displaying the registration form, validating input data, handling form submissions, and creating new customer accounts.

classes.name: Register
classes.description: Controller class responsible for handling user registration processes in the catalog part of Opencart.

methods.name: index
methods.description: Handles displaying the registration form with all necessary data such as breadcrumbs, customer groups, custom fields, captcha, and information acknowledgment.

methods.name: save
methods.description: Processes the registration form submission, validates inputs, creates a new customer, logs the customer in if applicable, and redirects to the success page.
